name: Smith and Morehouse Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231943 (99 days observed, edges closes)
note: Uinta-Wasatch-Cache NF, Kamas RD, near Oakley/Smith and Morehouse Reservoir (~7,800 ft). 34 paved sites, no hookups; host firewood. Mix of reservable and first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Anderson Cove Campground (Pineview Reservoir)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232013 (328 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: USFS (Ogden RD, Uinta-Wasatch-Cache NF) high-standard campground on Pineview Reservoir, ~10 mi E of Ogden. 111 sites (58 single, 9 double, 9 yurts, 31 walk-to tent); boat ramp and swim beach on site. Mostly reservable on recreation.gov with some FCFS. --Claude

name: Johnny Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10250569 (63 days observed, edges closes)
note: Okanogan-Wenatchee NF (Wenatchee River RD), along Icicle Creek ~12 miles SW of Leavenworth; 65 sites in Upper and Lower loops (56 single, 9 double). Lower loop (sites 1-15) sits along Icicle Creek; upper loop has larger spaces (RVs to ~50 ft). Mostly first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Rock Island Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10250654 (39 days observed, edges closes)
note: Okanogan-Wenatchee NF campground straddling Icicle Creek ~17 mi up Icicle Creek Rd from Leavenworth; 22 sites (20 single, 2 double), potable water hand pump. Scan & Pay on-site. --Claude

name: Ida Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10250564 (69 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Okanogan-Wenatchee campground at the confluence of Ida Creek and Icicle Creek (~13 mi up Icicle Rd from Leavenworth), 10 single drive-in sites, no hookups, max trailer 30 ft, ~2,500 ft, concessionaire-operated; --Claude

name: Early Winters Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10314652 (146 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS (Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, Methow Valley RD) campground ~15 mi W of Winthrop on Hwy 20 along Early Winters Creek near its Methow River confluence. 12 sites in a north and south loop (south loop handles RV/trailer traffic, open pine forest). Scan-and-pay via Recreation.gov app on site. Open ~Apr-Nov. --Claude

name: Bonaparte Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 252036 (161 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Okanogan-Wenatchee NF (Tonasket RD), ~3,600 ft on the south end of Bonaparte Lake east of Tonasket. 33 individual/family sites plus 1 group site; boat launch, accessible fishing dock. Some sites reservable online, single/double sites also FCFS; open ~May 15-Oct 17. --Claude

name: Klipchuck Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10314697 (138 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS campground in Okanogan-Wenatchee NF (Methow Valley RD), ~18 mi west of Winthrop off Hwy 20 then 1.3 mi on FR 300 (maintained gravel spur); 46 forested sites, RVs to 34 ft (fits a 23-ft rig; many sites unlevel, arrive early), vault toilets and hand-pump water. Near Early Winters Creek. --Claude

name: Cinder Hill Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233192 (118 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF campground on the NE shore of East Lake in the Newberry Volcano caldera (Newberry National Volcanic Monument). ~108 sites for tents/trailers/RVs (sites accommodate roughly 30-65 ft, not all sites fit all lengths), no hookups, drinking water, flush/vault toilets, boat ramp (10 mph lake). Reservable online in season, FCFS late Sept until mid-Oct close. --Claude

name: Fall River Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 267073 (131 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground beside Fall River. 12 nonelectric sites, no hookups; site max lengths vary (some to 24 ft, some to 30-40 ft). Vault toilets, no potable water at some sites. Reservable, becomes FCFS mid-Sept. Rough access road for larger rigs. --Claude
